videoBrief.prompt:
Imported screenplay: Heidi and Otto — Speaking proof

Animate the supplied populated frame as a speaking-animal movie shot. Exactly TWO photorealistic Bernese Mountain Dogs: HEIDI elderly silver muzzle burgundy collar LEFT foreground; OTTO stocky ochre collar RIGHT background. The spoken voice originates visibly from HEIDI: synchronize her canine jaw and muzzle to EVERY spoken word. This is ON-CAMERA CHARACTER DIALOGUE, NOT narration or voiceover. Clearly visible speech articulation while preserving canine anatomy: no human lips or teeth. Only Otto keeps his mouth closed. No humans, extra animals, figures in background, props, camera moves or cuts. Same low older female voice throughout.

script.title: Heidi and Otto — 10-second speaking proof
script.sourceTranscript:
HEIDI: Otto. You were meant to clear the path.
HEIDI: Not bring it in. Breakfast is waiting.
script.sourceDescription: A simple two-dog exposition exchange establishing Heidi’s authority and Otto’s groundskeeping work, ending with an invitation to breakfast.

shots.title: The muddy groundskeeper
shots.dialogue:
HEIDI: Otto. You were meant to clear the path.
HEIDI: Not bring it in. Breakfast is waiting.
shots.visual: 0–0.3s: Heidi turns eyes toward Otto. 0.3–3.6s: Heidi says the first sentence with clearly synchronized jaw and muzzle articulation. Her mouth opens and closes with each word; Otto listens with closed mouth. 3.6–4.3s: brief beat; Otto glances downward with eyes only; Heidi takes a breath. 4.3–7.7s: Heidi says second sentence, same voice and synchronized mouth. Her tone softens at Breakfast. 7.7–10s: both mouths close; brief shared look. Otto lifts eyes back to Heidi; no moving bodies or standing. Do not add a long pause between sentences.
shots.audio: Heidi alone speaks both sentences, on-camera synchronized performance. No voiceover or narrator. No music, only quiet continuous room ambience.
